podcast_name: Caffeinate Your Career: Coffee and Conversation with Career and Financial Experts
question: When did Caffeinate Your Career first launch as a live stream and podcast?
transcript_excerpt: The very first live stream was January 4th of 2022. Jason Hopper has been doing the podcast and live stream for over five years, initially with co-hosts Allison Harding and Phil Kinecki discussing three different job search topics per episode.

podcast_name: Caffeinate Your Career: Coffee and Conversation with Career and Financial Experts
question: Who created the title for the Caffeinate Your Career podcast and live stream?
transcript_excerpt: Allison Harding, who was the senior director of the department, created the title for the live stream. She suggested it and said 'I think that sounds good,' with the concept being to get yourself a cup of coffee and tune in to see the show.

podcast_name: Caffeinate Your Career: Coffee and Conversation with Career and Financial Experts
question: What is Jason Hopper's last day at JFS of Dallas?
transcript_excerpt: Jason Hopper's official last day with JFS is September 18th. This is due to a restructuring in his department where they decided to have only one career coach and one financial coach going forward, and he was affected by this restructuring.

podcast_name: Caffeinate Your Career: Coffee and Conversation with Career and Financial Experts
question: How much time did Jason Hopper spend creating each 40-minute episode of Caffeinate Your Career?
transcript_excerpt: It would take two and a half to three hours just to create one 40-minute podcast episode. Almost all of that time was spent in creating the event and writing the episode notes, which involved researching articles on the topic and combining them together.

podcast_name: Caffeinate Your Career: Coffee and Conversation with Career and Financial Experts
question: At what point in the broadcast did Caffeinate Your Career viewership typically drop off?
transcript_excerpt: Over the years, Jason Hopper observed that everyone would be tuned in at the start, but then they would start dropping off around 40 minutes into the live stream. This observation led him to adjust the show format to keep it at approximately 40 minutes rather than a full hour.
